cargo_findings.bounded_assessment: Trigger requires element Drop to panic. Resolver im-rc elements are Cargo-owned data: PackageId (Copy), Summary/Dependency (Arc-owned metadata), DepsFrame (Summary plus RcVecIter<DepInfo>); DepInfo contains Dependency, Rc<Vec<Summary>>, Rc<BTreeSet<InternedString>>. im-rc has no custom Drop implementation; its non-pool wrappers use std::rc::Rc, and refpool is absent from source lock. Tiny fixture introduces no artifact/platform values or executable code into these types. Narrow trigger assessment, not a general soundness claim.
